target: At least one qualifying Suomi-NPP hotspot detection in one county-clipped grid cell during one UTC week
tie_break: Earliest week, then numeric latitude and longitude grid indices
evaluation_kind: Exploratory retrospective comparison; these archive years have previously been inspected
limitations: The target is observed hotspot activity, not independent ignitions, burned area or a firefighting outcome.
No detection is not proof of no fire: cloud and observation-opportunity masks are unavailable.
Inputs use reprocessed archives with a two-day acquisition embargo; actual operational publication times are not established.
Non-overlapping 28-day windows include quiet periods. The final incomplete window is excluded.
Equal weights and grid size are fixed without tuning against this comparison; no statistical superiority or generalization claim is made.
Weather forecasts and EMIT indices are excluded from these rankings because matched historical coverage is unavailable.
County-clipped 0.2-degree cells differ in area. All methods and the visitor use the same cells and one cell-week budget.
Outcomes are bundled in this static educational site. Locking a guess is an interaction convention, not a blind scientific trial.
